## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Barcelona, Spain. It starts at Carrer de Larrard, 41.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Sagrada Família wasn't the only thing Gaudí didn't finish. There are other works that never got to see the light of day. In this exciting exhibition you'll learn all about them - plus dive into a 4D experience. The Gaudí Experience is a thrilling introduction to his ideas, his designs, and his architectural masterpieces.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €9.56. It was rated 4.0 out of 5 from 176 ratings and 96 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
